add_library(board INTERFACE)

target_sources(board
    INTERFACE
    board.c
    board_pl.c
    board_usb.c
)

target_include_directories(board
    INTERFACE
    .
)

target_link_libraries(board
    INTERFACE
    soc
    driver
    lzma
)

# Generated by the "Convert Bitstream" task; re-run CMake configure after regenerating it.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/board_pl_bitstream.c")
    target_sources(board INTERFACE board_pl_bitstream.c)
endif()
